attBesluta.text: Excellent buy for the price. The black is nice and really makes a big difference in seeing through it. It's a little lighter than similar meshes I've purchased in the past, but for a third of the price I would expect that.
Purchased online a few days ago. Easy to put together and sturdy.
Holds a very good amount of weight, sturdy and precisely what I needed.
Qualität ausgezeichnet, Lieferung schnell und einfach

Fabulous table to use for grilling and smoking outside! It is super simple to set up by myself with no struggle whatsoever. Also easily wipes clean for fast cleanup. I would highly recommend getting this table!
The workbench is the perfect size, a great tool for kitchen organization, and sturdy and durable.
awesome work table for my floral design company. Great to have on hand and add to your workspace.
Love the table. Works well, light weight. Like the adjustable feet.
Nice folding legs, nice size, stainless steel thickness is thin, shelf is thin and I'm anticipating many dents, easy to store. Overall 6.75/10.

Bought 3 (4x30 with shelf) to replace 2 heavy duty SS tables on wheels. These were used at the HLSS&R ‹NAMN› Cook-Off. Served the purpose, but really light weight. Clamped them together to make them more stable. Only issue is that for Stainless Steel, they rusted very quickly. Cleaned with scrubbing pad to remove the rust & dried before putting away. These tables would not hold up if used outside and not protected from moisture. Would be good for interior use. Easy to fold and unfold the legs.

Set this winch up in my cattle yard. I used a temporary mounting design, as it is not needed all the time. I used it when one of my cattle could not successfully give birth to her calf. It works extremely well, and mother and calf are doing just fine.
Todo correcto, solo falta probarlo pero parece fuerte
